name: pdf-to-excel
description: Turn the tables in a text PDF into a real Excel workbook and CSV files.

interface.longDescription:
Convert a PDF table to Excel and download real XLSX files that open in Excel: Zovo PDF to Spreadsheet reads the tables in a text-based PDF (bank statements, invoices, product lists, reports) and returns one Excel sheet per table plus a ZIP of CSV files. Numbers within spreadsheet precision stay numeric; higher-precision values remain text with a warning. Dates become spreadsheet dates in a US format, and each table comes with detected column types and a preview of the first rows so you can check the result before you use it.

The plugin finds a table by its rows and aligned columns (3 rows or more, 2 columns or more), joins the last table on a page to the first on the next page only when their column counts and source headers match after whitespace collapse. Rows outside detected tables are retained in an Other text sheet (Page, Line, Text) and other-text.csv. It reads numbers written as 1,234.56 or 1.234,56, negatives in parentheses or with a trailing minus, currency symbols and percent, and dates written as ISO (2026-03-05), MM/DD/YYYY or DD/MM/YYYY. A page with no text layer is reported as a scanned page instead of guessed.

The widget shows a preview of each table with a table selector and a per-column type switch (text, number or date) that changes the export, plus Download Excel and Download CSV files buttons. Generated files are kept for about one hour, then deleted.

Limitations: text-based PDFs only (scanned pages are not read; run OCR first), complex layouts with merged cells may need a manual check, and a file is limited to 15 MB and 50 pages. A text cell over 32,767 characters must be split in the source before export. It does not edit the PDF and does not read image-only pages.

Extract the table from this PDF and give me a spreadsheet I can open
Turn this bank statement PDF into an Excel workbook and CSV files

positive.description: Price list with numbers and text
positive.prompt: Convert the tables in the attached price-list PDF to Excel with one sheet per table
positive.expected_behavior: Calls convert_pdf_tables on the attached price-list PDF and reports 1 table with 5 data rows and 3 columns typed text, number, number. The preview shows 'Widget A' and the unit price 1,234.56 stored as the number 1234.56, and 7.99 as 7.99. The result offers an Excel workbook (one sheet, Table 1) and a CSV ZIP that holds table-1.csv.

positive.description: Inspect a bank statement before exporting
positive.prompt: Show me what tables are in this PDF statement and how the columns are typed
positive.expected_behavior: Calls list_pdf_tables on the statement PDF and reports 1 table with 60 data rows and 4 columns typed date, text, number, number; the pages 1 and 2 are joined and the repeated header appears once. No download files are offered, and the result suggests convert_pdf_tables for the Excel and CSV export.

positive.prompt: Turn this 2-page bank statement PDF into an Excel workbook and CSV files
positive.expected_behavior: Calls convert_pdf_tables and returns 1 table with 60 data rows and 4 columns. Amounts such as 2,450.00 become the number 2450 and -82.17 stays -82.17, dates are stored as Excel dates, and the downloads are an Excel workbook plus a CSV ZIP.

positive.description: A report with two different tables
positive.prompt: Convert this PDF report to an Excel workbook; it has two different tables
positive.expected_behavior: Calls convert_pdf_tables and finds 2 tables: Table 1 (Item, Qty) with 5 data rows, and Table 2 (Name, Score, Grade) with 5 data rows and scores such as 91 kept as numbers. The workbook has two sheets and the CSV ZIP holds two files.

positive.description: Day-first dates in an orders list
positive.prompt: Convert this orders PDF to Excel and keep the dates as dates
positive.expected_behavior: Calls convert_pdf_tables and reads the Placed column as dates with the DD/MM order, shown as 25/03/2026, and types Total as number so $1,200.00 becomes 1200. Downloads are an Excel workbook and a CSV ZIP.

negative.description: Scans and photos are out of scope. Expected: the tool is not called; the assistant explains that a photo or scan has no text layer, says no OCR is done, and suggests running OCR first.
negative.prompt: What does this photo of my receipt say?

negative.description: PDF editing is out of scope. Expected: the tool is not called; the assistant explains that this plugin reads tables into Excel and CSV and does not delete or edit pages of a PDF.
negative.prompt: Can you delete page 3 from my PDF?

negative.description: QR codes are a different job. Expected: the tool is not called; the assistant explains it converts PDF tables to Excel, not QR codes.
negative.prompt: Make a QR code for my restaurant menu

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: find the tables in a text-based PDF, type their columns (text, number, date), and download an Excel workbook (one sheet per table) plus a ZIP of CSV files, with a preview and a per-column type switch in the widget.

pl-PL.subtitle: Tabele z PDF do Excela i CSV
pl-PL.description: Konwertuj tabele z pliku PDF do skoroszytu Excel (jedno arkusze na tabelę) oraz plików CSV. Wtyczka odczytuje tabele w tekstowym pliku PDF (wyciągi bankowe, faktury, cenniki, raporty), rozpoznaje typy kolumn i pokazuje podgląd pierwszych wierszy. Liczby pozostają liczbami, daty stają się datami Excel w formacie amerykańskim, a nagłówek powtarzany na kolejnej stronie jest usuwany przy łączeniu tabeli. Ograniczenia: tylko pliki PDF z warstwą tekstową (bez OCR), złożone układy z scalonymi komórkami mogą wymagać sprawdzenia ręcznego, maksymalnie 15 MB i 50 stron.

de-DE.subtitle: PDF-Tabellen zu Excel und CSV
de-DE.description: Wandle die Tabellen in einer textbasierten PDF in eine Excel-Arbeitsmappe (ein Blatt pro Tabelle) und CSV-Dateien um. Das Plugin liest Tabellen in PDFs (Kontoauszüge, Rechnungen, Preislisten, Berichte), erkennt Spaltentypen und zeigt eine Vorschau der ersten Zeilen. Zahlen bleiben Zahlen, Datumsangaben werden zu Excel-Datumsangaben im US-Format, und eine auf der Folgeseite wiederholte Kopfzeile wird beim Zusammenführen entfernt. Einschränkungen: nur PDFs mit Textebene (kein OCR), komplexe Layouts mit verbundenen Zellen können eine manuelle Prüfung erfordern, höchstens 15 MB und 50 Seiten.

es-ES.subtitle: Tablas de PDF a Excel y CSV
es-ES.description: Convierte las tablas de un PDF con capa de texto en un libro de Excel (una hoja por tabla) y archivos CSV. La extensión lee las tablas de facturas, estados de cuenta, listas de precios e informes, detecta el tipo de cada columna y muestra una vista previa de las primeras filas. Los números siguen siendo números, las fechas se convierten en fechas de Excel con formato de EE. UU. y la fila de encabezado repetida en una página siguiente se elimina al unir la tabla. Limitaciones: solo PDF con texto (sin OCR), los diseños complejos con celdas combinadas pueden necesitar una revisión manual, y el archivo se limita a 15 MB y 50 páginas.

fr-FR.subtitle: Tableaux PDF vers Excel et CSV
fr-FR.description: Convertissez les tableaux d'un PDF texte en classeur Excel (une feuille par tableau) et en fichiers CSV. L'extension lit les tableaux des relevés, factures, listes de prix et rapports, détecte le type de chaque colonne et affiche un aperçu des premières lignes. Les nombres restent des nombres, les dates deviennent des dates Excel au format américain, et la ligne d'en-tête répétée sur la page suivante est supprimée lors de la fusion du tableau. Limites : PDF avec couche de texte uniquement (pas d'OCR), les mises en page complexes avec cellules fusionnées peuvent demander une vérification manuelle, et le fichier est limité à 15 Mo et 50 pages.

ja-JP.subtitle: PDFの表をExcelとCSVに変換
ja-JP.description: テキスト形式のPDFにある表を、Excelブック（表ごとに1シート）とCSVファイルに変換します。請求書、明細、価格表、レポートなどのPDFから表を読み取り、列の種類を判定して先頭行のプレビューを表示します。数値は数値のまま、日付は米国形式のExcelの日付になり、次ページで繰り返される見出し行は表を結合するときに取り除かれます。制限：テキストレイヤーのあるPDFのみ（OCRなし）、結合セルを含む複雑なレイアウトは手動での確認が必要な場合があります。ファイルは最大15 MB、50ページまでです。

pt-BR.subtitle: Tabelas PDF para Excel e CSV
pt-BR.description: Converta as tabelas de um PDF com texto em uma pasta de trabalho do Excel (uma planilha por tabela) e arquivos CSV. A extensão lê tabelas de extratos, faturas, listas de preços e relatórios, detecta o tipo de cada coluna e mostra uma prévia das primeiras linhas. Os números continuam sendo números, as datas viram datas do Excel no formato dos EUA, e a linha de cabeçalho repetida em uma página seguinte é removida ao juntar a tabela. Limitações: apenas PDF com camada de texto (sem OCR), layouts complexos com células mescladas podem exigir conferência manual, e o arquivo é limitado a 15 MB e 50 páginas.
